proposed_widenings.name: passive class feature family
proposed_widenings.justification: Aura of Protection is always active with no activation cost, no use count, and no rest reset. The only existing ClassFeatureMechanics family is 'activation', which requires activationCost + resource + resetCadence. A 'passive' (always-on) family does not exist.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You radiate a protective, unseeable aura in a 10-foot Emanation that originates from you.

proposed_widenings.name: emanation attachment
proposed_widenings.justification: The aura covers a 10-foot Emanation centered on and moving with the paladin. Existing 'area' attachment has a fixed origin (point_within_range or on_primary_target). An emanation is a distinct shape: origin is 'self', moves with the source, and applies to allies within radius.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You radiate a protective, unseeable aura in a 10-foot Emanation that originates from you.

proposed_widenings.name: ability_modifier expression in roll modifier amount
proposed_widenings.justification: The saving throw bonus equals the paladin's current Charisma modifier (minimum 1). DiceAmount and DiceDelta can only express fixed dice expressions or level-tiered values, not runtime stat-derived values. A new AmountSource variant is needed: { kind: 'ability_modifier', ability: Ability, minimum: number }.
proposed_widenings.evidence: gain a bonus to saving throws equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum bonus of +1)

proposed_widenings.name: save modifier effect for ClassFeatureEffect
proposed_widenings.justification: The effect is a saving throw bonus applied to all allies in the emanation. ClassFeatureEffect only covers grant_extra_action and heal_hp. A modify_roll_numeric variant (parallel to the spell OngoingOperation of the same name) is needed in ClassFeatureEffect.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You and your allies in the aura gain a bonus to saving throws equal to your Charisma modifier

proposed_widenings.name: condition_suppression gate
proposed_widenings.justification: The aura is inactive while the paladin has the Incapacitated condition. No variant exists in ClassFeatureMechanics to express 'this feature is suppressed while the owner has condition X'. This is a deactivation trigger, not a resource or rest reset.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The aura is inactive while you have the Incapacitated condition.

notes: Cannot encode honestly. Every structural element is missing: no passive family, no emanation attachment, no ability-modifier amount expression, no save modifier in ClassFeatureEffect, no condition-based suppression. The exclusive-use interaction rule ('a creature can benefit from only one Aura of Protection at a time') is an additional cross-feature interaction that also has no representation.
